observed: One vertical solid wall at left; diagonal hatching lies on the solid side.
Liquid lies to the right and below its surface. The surface is high at the wall and bends downward to a nearly horizontal level farther right.
A solid tangent ray leaves the contact line downward-right, into the liquid-side sector.
The sole source label is theta. Its acute angle is between the downward wall ray and the downward-right tangent, measured through liquid.
Horizontal short hatch strokes distinguish liquid. No numerical angle, scale, force arrow, gap, or additional membrane.
originalInventory.modern_mapping: Deterministic qualitative wetting wall, smooth meniscus, tangent and liquid-side acute angle. Layout angle is not a source measurement or the zero-angle quantitative limit. Semantic fill and English Liquid are explicit modern identification additions.
